usedFor: Trafft holds appointments and customers, and Zoom registers them for a webinar through “Register Attendee for Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “Appointment Booked” in Trafft, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A booked appointment registers the customer for a webinar without a manual step.

watchOut: “Appointment Status Changed” in Trafft fires on any change, so the same appointment can run again.
